theories.claim: Tree identity digest in copyBoundedTree and collectTreeIdentity is order-dependent because filepath.WalkDir order is filesystem-dependent and hashes are accumulated in walk order without sorting
theories.basis: internal/platform/process/isolation.go:317-371 copyBoundedTree hashes rel+data in WalkDir callback order; 373-433 collectTreeIdentity does same. No sort before hashing. Digest is hex of sha256 of concatenated entries. CompareTrees and ChangedPaths rely on digest equality; CreateIsolation verifies copy identity digest == re-collected digest (125). If walk order differs between copy and collect, or across runs, digest mismatch can cause spurious 'isolated copy identity does not match its source' cleanup even for valid trees.
theories.confirmation_condition: Demonstrate two successive IdentifyTree/CreateIsolation digests differ for same content due to differing WalkDir order, or show WalkDir order not guaranteed sorted and hash not sorted, or reproduce flaky TestIsolationCopiesNonGitTreeRunsAndCleans failure on inconsistent digest
theories.refutation_condition: Show code sorts entries before hashing or WalkDir is proven deterministically sorted on all supported platforms/filesystems, or digest comparison is stable in tests
theories.inconclusive_condition: Cannot execute filesystem-order variation or run reproduction without execution; static read alone does not prove runtime ordering variance
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read-only inspection of copyBoundedTree and collectTreeIdentity hashing loops; compare to SortedEnvironment and compareTreeEntries which do sort; request go-source-integrity check without execution
